title: fix: 8k clips get a scaled-frame library icon

commit.merge_subject: merge: fix: 8k clips get a scaled-frame library icon

description:
The encoded icon pass developed the full frame on the CPU and scaled
afterwards. An 8K clip needs two 133 MB ARGB arrays, ran out of JVM heap,
and never got an icon. Clips above DCI 4K, and any clip whose develop
fails, now take MediaMetadataRetriever.getScaledFrameAtTime instead.
changed: fix: 8k clips get a scaled-frame library icon
